node_definition.done_when: A test in tests/test_close_names_each_deferred_section_and_moves_it.py asserts close on a fixture with two deferred sections is refused through _require_every_section_ticked in reckon/_store.py, whose report names both sections and both remedies (descope with a reason, or descope with moved_to naming the successor section). After one is descoped with a reason and the other with a resolving moved_to, close succeeds; the successor section carries the moved section's prose, effort, capability and open gate and lists the incoming move; each comment anchored on the moved section is re-anchored on the successor or on the move record; and no gate or comment on either plan names a missing section. A moved_to that does not resolve is refused. PLAN-FORMAT.md, the reckon-edit skill and docs/_shared/plan.schema.json (regenerated with write_json_schema) state moved_to in the same commit. On the base commit the refusal names neither remedy and the test fails there. The negative control is executed and logged. Gate: tests/test_close_names_each_deferred_section_and_moves_it.py tests/test_schema.py tests/test_a_plan_closes_in_one_op.py. baseline_suite and after_suite are run with the project's armed suite command, PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider -q tests/test_close_names_each_deferred_section_and_moves_it.py, at the base and at the head, each log naming its revision, tree and literal command and ending EXIT=. Every test file that imports a production module the node changed adds no failure against a base arm: run both arms from git archive extractions on node-local disk with the main checkout's .env linked, record both logs, and re-run any id that differs between arms serially three times on each revision. ruff check and ruff format --check add no findings on the staged paths. Run the gate in the foreground on the fleet allocation.
